references.note: third-party BGA wiki card page; re-checked 2026-11-24 (page rev. 2024/10/10). Confirmed: cost 1 wood (コスト: 1 木), prerequisite 2 occupations (条件: 職業2), points 1 (勝利点: 1), effect = 'このカードは畑である。各収穫の畑フェイズで、このカードから品物1以上を収穫したならば、食料1を得る。' (this card is a field; during each harvest's field phase, if at least 1 good is harvested from this card, gain 1 food).

English list page row re-checked 2026-11-24 (list rev. 2026/06/12). Confirmed effect text: 'This card is a field. During the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 1 good from this card, you also get 1 food.' List row carries no cost/prereq/points columns.

effects.notes: This card is a field on your board (card-as-field modeling not in the vocabulary); the wiki does not restrict its crops.
During each harvest's field phase, if at least 1 good was harvested from this card, gain 1 food.

unresolved_fields: effects: card-as-field modeling ('this card is a field') is not covered by the effect vocabulary (BQ-7 / R-C1). Re-checked 2026-11-24: JA p=2681 + EN list confirm 'このカードは畑である / This card is a field'; residual is engine-design, not literature-decidable.

effects.1.granularity: source confirms '各収穫の畑フェイズで、このカードから品物1以上を収穫したならば、食料1を得る / During the field phase of each harvest, if you harvest at least 1 good from this card, you also get 1 food'; the per-card-field harvest granularity in the engine remains undecided (BQ-7).
review.notes: Cost: 1 wood (JA table: コスト=1 木). Prerequisite: 2 occupations (JA table: 条件=職業2). Printed points: 1 (JA table: 勝利点=1). Sources: JA p=2681 (rev. 2024/10/10), EN cardlist_en/ (rev. 2026/06/12), both re-checked 2026-11-24. Third-party BGA wiki cross-check only; not official Lookout verification.
